title: Genshin Track Support, Game Data Sync & Submodule Fixes
summary: Added Genshin Track as a supported build optimizer and progression dashboard, synced character and material game catalogs to genshin-db 5.2.15 (introducing Mitya and Valeriy), and fixed repository submodule initialization.

changes.text: Supported Optimizer – Genshin Track: Added integration and documentation links for Genshin Track (genshintrack.com/dashboard) across the GOOD export guide, homepage SEO workflows, and account planning roadmaps.

Character & Material Catalog Update: Synchronized canonical game database with genshin-db 5.2.15, importing new playable characters Mitya and Valeriy, generating lossless 64² WebP reference atlases, and updating material catalogs.

Sync Scraper Resilience: Fixed missing image handling for newly added characters, added Fandom image lookup for missing bait items, and cached existing weapon and artifact WebP icons to drastically accelerate builds.
Git Submodule Repository Cloning: Resolved corrupted git refs and clone branches across all submodules (gi-helper, gi-docs, gi-sync-catalogue, gi-tests) in the suite.
